title: A viewer is never refused for the cores of a job that has just been given up
description: A CI-shaped run saw PlaybackInfo refuse a spec for cores ('the most any worker has free is 0.0') right after a held worker's job was given up, 1 run of 3.
acceptanceCriteria: A check forces the order (PlaybackInfo asked right after a job is given up by a held worker) with real processes, and fails before any fix
The record says what a viewer would have seen in production: a retry or failover answered "cannot be played" for cores that were free, and for how long
Verdict is product, test or cause unknown (D-042); not reproducing is never a verdict of test

If product: the cores a given-up, stopped or failed-over job held are free for admission by the time its viewer can ask again, shown on every give-up path; the fix returns as a brief first if it changes what a lease guarantees
If test: the test waits for what it claims and still fails on a wrong product
No retry, skip or raised timeout; no product code changed to fit a test
JS-161's admission keeps this check passing
notes: Builds beside JS-161 and never holds it, nor JS-041 or JS-157 (D-050). Merged 4f0fcd5 (#252).
